sql: SELECT json_build_object('msgs', (SELECT json_agg(m ORDER BY m.timestamp) FROM (SELECT m.timestamp, m.from_me, m.message_type, m.metadata->>'source' AS src, left(m.content, 700) AS txt FROM wapi_messages m JOIN wapi_conversations c ON c.id = m.conversation_id WHERE c.contact_phone LIKE '%11963539901%' ORDER BY m.timestamp DESC LIMIT 30) m), 'conv', (SELECT json_agg(json_build_object('bot_step', c.bot_step, 'handoff', c.bot_data->'ai_handoff', 'mes', c.bot_data->'mes', 'data_festa', c.bot_data->'data_festa', 'convidados', c.bot_data->'convidados', 'periodo', c.bot_data->'periodo')) FROM wapi_conversations c WHERE c.contact_phone LIKE '%11963539901%'), 'degustacao_config', (SELECT json_agg(json_build_object('campo', e.key, 'trecho', substring(e.value from greatest(1, position('egusta' in lower(e.value)) - 300) for 900))) FROM ai_agent_settings s, jsonb_each_text(to_jsonb(s)) e WHERE e.value ILIKE '%degusta%')) AS r
